### GETTING HERE

Taxis

Taxis/Ubers can come directly into the development with a drop off at Pump House lane, and then a 2 minute walk along the river to Power Station and up to Level 3 for The Cinema in the Power Station.

For the Cinema in the Arches, they can also be directed to the bottom of Sopwith Way, and then it is a 2 minute walk under the Bridge entrance and to the left down Arches Lane.

Underground

Battersea Power Station - The new Northern line extension is now open. On exit, turn left and it is a short walk to The Cinema in the Arches (turn left at Moyses Stevens Flower Shop) or 2 minutes to the Battersea Power Station entrance and then up to level 1 for entrance to The Cinema in the Power Station.

Sloane Square - 12 minute walk or a short ride on bus route '137' or '452' stopping at "Battersea Park / Chelsea Gate" and then short walk.

River Buses

Operated by MBNA Thames Clippers and accept Oyster Cards and contactless. Journey times from:

Embankment: 15 Minutes    
Blackfriars: 20 minutes    
Canary Wharf: 40 minutes

Always check the timetable as some services don’t run all day. We are just around the corner from the jetty (150 meters) in Arches Lane.

Timetable: [https://tfl.gov.uk/river-bus/timetable/rb2/](https://tfl.gov.uk/river-bus/timetable/rb2/)

Buses

From Chelsea Bridge Road: bus routes '44', '137', '452' to "Battersea Park / Chelsea Gate" stop, then 2 minute walk.

Trains

Approximate distances to both The Cinema in the Power Station and The Cinema in the Arches: 

Battersea Park station - 10 minute walk 

Queenstown Road Station - 15 minute walk 

Victoria Station - 20 minute walk or a short ride on bus route '44', stopping at "Chelsea Bridge Wharf”.

Parking

Battersea Circus West (SW11 8EZ) 24 hours a day.

To access the car park, enter from Battersea Park road and drive straight along Pump House Lane. Turn left as you reach the new development and drive into the underground car park. 

**Park your car for up to 4 hours free when visting the cinemas, simply present your parking ticket to the box office for validation***

**Valid for Battersea Power Station car parks only. Validation offered alongside a purchased cinema ticket only.*

# The Most Immersive Cinema Experience at Battersea Power Station

Cinema was never meant to be background entertainment.

It was designed to transport, captivate and immerse.

Located within London's iconic Battersea Power Station, Olympic Studios Battersea is built around that belief. Combining **Dolby Cinema**, luxury seating and intimate screening rooms with one of London's most exciting destinations, it offers a cinema experience that goes far beyond simply watching a film.

As one of only two Dolby Cinema venues in London, Olympic Studios Battersea delivers a level of picture quality, sound and immersion that few cinemas can match. It has also become a destination for film premieres, special screenings, red carpet events and exclusive Q&As with some of the biggest names in film and entertainment.

If you're looking for the best cinema in Battersea, the ultimate Dolby Cinema experience in London, or a premium alternative to the traditional multiplex, you've found it.

## Experience Dolby Cinema

Not all cinema technology is created equal.

Dolby Cinema combines the extraordinary visual power of **Dolby Vision** with the breathtaking realism of **Dolby Atmos**, creating a cinema experience designed to bring audiences closer to every story.

Dolby Vision unlocks remarkable brightness, contrast and colour, revealing details that standard projection systems simply cannot reproduce.

Dolby Atmos surrounds audiences with multidimensional sound that moves naturally throughout the auditorium, allowing every whisper, musical note and cinematic moment to be experienced exactly as filmmakers intended.

The result is simple.

You stop watching the film.

You start feeling part of it.

## One of Only Two Dolby Cinema Experiences in London

For serious film lovers, technology matters.

As one of only two Dolby Cinema locations in London, Olympic Studios Battersea offers a rare opportunity to experience the latest releases using some of the most advanced cinema technology available anywhere in the world.

Whether it's the scale of a blockbuster, the subtlety of a drama or the power of a live event screening, Dolby Cinema delivers extraordinary clarity, depth and realism.

This is cinema at its absolute best.

## A Destination for Film Premieres, Red Carpets and Exclusive Events

Olympic Studios Battersea is more than a cinema. It has become one of London's most exciting destinations for the film industry itself.

Throughout the year, the venue hosts film premieres, red carpet screenings, cast and filmmaker Q&As, influencer events, private screenings and special cinematic experiences that bring audiences closer to the people behind the stories on screen.

From major studio releases to independent film launches, guests regularly have the opportunity to experience films alongside directors, actors, producers and creatives who helped bring them to life.

For film lovers, there are few experiences more memorable than hearing directly from the people who made the film moments after the credits roll.

## Located Inside Battersea Power Station

Few cinemas in London can match their surroundings.

Set within the historic Battersea Power Station, our cinema sits at the heart of one of the capital's most vibrant destinations. Surrounded by world class restaurants, bars, shopping, riverside walks and cultural experiences, a visit to Olympic Studios Battersea becomes much more than a trip to the movies.

Arrive early for dinner. Stay afterwards for drinks. Spend the afternoon exploring the Power Station before settling into one of London's most immersive cinema experiences.

The film is only part of the experience.

## The Best Cinema In Battersea

Whether you're searching for:

- Dolby Cinema London
- Dolby Atmos Cinema London
- Cinema Battersea Power Station
- Luxury cinema London
- Best cinema in London
- Film premieres London
- Celebrity Q&A screenings London
- Red carpet screenings London
- Cinema Chelsea
- Cinema Fulham
- Cinema Victoria
- Cinema Nine Elms
- Immersive cinema London

Olympic Studios Battersea offers a more immersive, comfortable and memorable alternative to traditional cinemas.

## Why Choose Olympic Studios Battersea?

### Dolby Cinema

Experience films with extraordinary depth, detail and realism.

Dolby Vision delivers exceptional image quality with brighter highlights, deeper blacks and richer colours, while Dolby Atmos creates a powerful three dimensional soundscape that places audiences at the centre of every scene.

Together they create one of the most advanced cinema experiences available in London.

### Luxury Seating

Comfort matters.

Spacious seating, generous legroom and thoughtfully designed auditoriums ensure every screening feels relaxed, comfortable and enjoyable.

### Intimate Screening Rooms

Bigger isn't always better.

Our screening rooms create a more personal and engaging atmosphere, allowing every seat to feel connected to the screen and every audience member to feel immersed in the story.

### A Complete Night Out

Located within Battersea Power Station, guests have immediate access to some of London's best restaurants, bars, shops and riverside spaces.

Unlike a standalone cinema visit, Olympic Studios Battersea offers the opportunity to build an entire day or evening around the experience.

### Beyond the Latest Releases

Alongside new films, we host special screenings, filmmaker conversations, cast appearances, cultural events, industry premieres and exclusive experiences that celebrate cinema beyond the screen.

## London's Destination For Immersive Cinema

There are many places to watch a film in London.

There are very few places where the technology, environment, comfort, culture and access to the film industry itself come together to create something truly memorable.

At Olympic Studios Battersea, every element has been designed around one goal: creating the most immersive cinema experience possible.

From the stunning picture quality of Dolby Vision and the enveloping sound of Dolby Atmos to red carpet premieres, celebrity Q&As and the unique surroundings of Battersea Power Station, this is cinema experienced at its fullest.

If a film is worth seeing, it is worth experiencing properly.

Discover what's showing today at Olympic Studios Battersea Power Station and experience one of London's only Dolby Cinema venues.
